title: Separated systematic and parity streams in 468 scalar operations

claims.statement: For the explicit systematic encoder with 33 punctured shift-remainder [60,30] blocks and one [20,10] block, and the deterministic minimum-weight syndrome-leader decoder specified in proof.md, the average block error on a uniform 1000-bit message sent through 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 199987129453415593/200000000000000000.
For the same explicit systematic product code and chosen-leader decoder, the fixed bsc-ops-v1 RAM program uses exactly W=468 operations for every 2000-bit received word, with W <= 2^(887037/100000).

experiments.purpose: Compute the complete exact syndrome histograms by an invertible change of basis and a mix of bitset shifts and complementary-mask enumeration, then check the exact error bound.
Count all primitive instructions, verify the exact operation exponent comparison, and check a reference-counter replay on sample inputs with exact precomputed table values at each accessed address.
